pageProps.title: China Panda 24h Main Branch
pageProps.review: China Panda 24h Main Branch, located in Oesanmi-dong, Osan, Gyeonggi-do, is a Chinese restaurant famous for its clean-tasting glutinous rice sweet and sour pork (Tang-su-yuk) and generous portions of delicious beef brisket Jjamppong. It also features a large parking lot.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Beef Brisket Jjamppong", "rating": 4 } --- It's not too spicy and tastes just right. ``` ```menu { "title": "Glutinous Rice Sweet and Sour Pork (Tang-su-yuk)", "rating": 4 } --- The batter is not too thick. ``` ## Review The food is clean and consistent. I liked that the seasoning wasn't overpowering. The sweet and sour pork didn't have any gamey smell, and the batter was just right. However, the Jjamppong was the real standout here—generous portions and perfectly balanced. The spacious parking lot is also a big plus. ## Pictures
